sun.security.ec.point

类 ProjectivePoint<T extends IntegerModuloP>

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.security.ec.point.ProjectivePoint<T>
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    Point
    直接已知子类:
    ProjectivePoint.Immutable, ProjectivePoint.Mutable

    public abstract class ProjectivePoint<T extends IntegerModuloP>
extends Object
implements Point
    Elliptic curve point in projective coordinates (X, Y, Z) where an affine point (x, y) is represented using any (X, Y, Z) s.t. x = X/Z and y = Y/Z.
